payload.summary: Refined the supervisor-roadmap ri-05 sketch into a full plan: one nullable supervisor_record JSONB column on handoff_documents carrying a self-versioned four-section record; a deterministic builder in cycle_state.py that derives active_changes from git-tracked state and carries pending gates, standing decisions and back-edge digest state forward; a tracked mirror for the non-derivable sections; register_agent.py untouched. Tier: coordinated. Gate 1 selected Approach 1.

decisions.title: Single nullable supervisor_record JSONB column with an inner schema_version, not four typed columns
decisions.rationale: The handoff payload crosses fourteen hand-written field lists; one key per surface is the only extension that stays reviewable, and inner versioning lets ri-06/ri-13 evolve sections without migrations.

decisions.title: Split the record on the derivable/non-derivable seam: active_changes is recomputed from loop-state.json and roadmap.yaml, the other three sections are carried forward and mirrored to openspec/supervise/supervisor-record.json
decisions.rationale: Honours 'git is truth; the database is a projection' without churning a tracked file on every phase transition; rehydration works with the coordinator down.

decisions.title: register_agent.py is not modified; /supervise rehydrates through try_handoff_read
decisions.rationale: Acceptance wording is 'without changes beyond the schema extension'; the hook must never slow startup and is being measured by record-doctor-context-cost-baseline.

decisions.title: Migration 034 drops the eight-argument write_handoff overload before recreating it with a defaulted ninth parameter
decisions.rationale: A second overload would make existing eight-argument RPC calls ambiguous in Postgres.

decisions.title: pending_gates entries require a deadline; back_edge.digested_stubs is keyed by cycle_state.stub_key
decisions.rationale: Supervisor ri-06 files escalations with deadlines and ri-13 must join digest state to the cycle ledger's seen_keys.

next_steps: Implement wp-contracts, then wp-coordinator / wp-host-plumbing / wp-supervisor-builder in parallel.
Keep register_agent.py out of every diff (verification step asserts it).
